description: This PHP file defines the SaveCustomFieldController class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, responsible for handling the creation and editing of custom fields in the Human Resource Management system. It extends a base controller, manages services, and prepares data for rendering the Vue component, including localization and available screen and field type lists.

classes.name: SaveCustomFieldController
classes.description: Controller for handling the save and edit operations for custom fields, including preparing Vue components with appropriate properties based on the request and system data.

methods.name: getCustomFieldService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of CustomFieldService used to interact with custom field data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with relevant data and properties prior to rendering, including handling existing custom field IDs, localization, and screen/field type lists.
